notes.title: Steam Next Fest Announcement - Demo available now!
notes.content:
The new [b]RunOut[/b] is here! During [b][u]Steam Next Fest from February 24th to March 3rd[/u][/b], the [b]RunOut - Hothead Paws[/b] demo will be available to download and play from our Steam Store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/cbc3137a4a361bf7127ca64164cbcd248e3b3fc1.png[/img]

[h2]No more Run and Fun Together – the new RunOut - Hothead Paws is here!
[/h2]
[h3]Big Changes
[/h3][list]
[*] New Gameplay - Have the time of your life with friends and other players.
[*] New in-game events will make each match a fresh experience - Falling Box, Safe Zone, Pinata, Hardcore Punch, and Last Man Standing.
[*] New Camera Switch feature – Switch between 3rd-person view and full camera view during the match, as you need.
[*] Server/region selection: choose between US/EU/ASIA/HK
[/list]
What you’ll find in this demo:

[h3]Meet the new RunOut - Hothead Paws, same friends, new game!
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Choose between 14 playable characters (6 of them to be unlocked), each with its own unique skills. Run through a dynamic stage, adapting to obstacles, traps, and random minigames!
[*] Fight your way against friends and foes in this chaotic, fun party game. 
[*] Collect coins by getting them through the map or just punch them away from your friends. Switch between the two camera modes to move precisely while keeping an eye on the dynamic level closing on you. 
[*] Steal the Spica Bear from your friends by hitting them with your unique skill or punches.
[*] Dance on their dropped coins for the ultimate BM.
[/list]

We hope you have a lot of fun with this demo!

Find friends to play on our [url=https://discord.gg/CAkuyykTBq]Discord server[/url] and follow us on our socials: [url=https://x.com/RunOut_Official]X (Twitter)[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/runout.game]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/runout_game]Instagram[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RunOut-Official]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@runoutofficial]TikTok[/url]

notes.title: Playtest starts this week!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Runners! Long time no see! [/h2]

We've been working behind the scenes, and we're so happy to invite everyone to our... 
[h3]Closed Playtest starting on November 21![/h3]

[b]We've got:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Features 
[*] New Weapons
[*] New Map
[*] All Characters unlocked for everyone
[/list]

If you want to join the playtest, please sign up using this form, and we'll contact you: 

[h2][url=https://forms.gle/nfMUbJtfPUZ8g5h49]Sign Up here![/url][/h2]

And invite your friends to sign up, so you can play together!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Even more Runners!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Runners! [/h2]

Today we want to introduce you to even more characters that will be available in RunOut! Each character comes with unique skills, so you can always choose a runner that fits your mood and strategy.


Before we begin, make sure that you added RunOut to your Steam Wishlists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438120/RunOut__Run__Fun_Together/

[h2]All done? Now, let’s meet even more of our runners! [/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Pando[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/6eeee43edd19a46efcd71fa8c6bcb823621e4b80.png[/img]
Meet [b]Pando[/b]! This chill and loveable runner spent years training Kung Fu, so when the time comes, he’s able to punch his opponents so hard that they’re literally set on fire! Don’t mess with Pando and his flaming fist!  

Choose [b]Pando[/b] if you want to show off your martial arts skills and beat your opponents both literally and figuratively.


[h2]Rinie[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/afd397efe44ea34817a29aee0317a7ad6736ba00.png[/img]
Meet [b]Rinie[/b]! When she wants to get to the finish line, you shouldn’t stand in her way. When she’s in a hurry, she can use her horn to send her competition flying, making the path to victory clean and empty!

Choose [b]Rinie[/b] if you want to bump your opponents right into space!

[h2]Akito[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/c572fa24eda6bbec0958a44ae9c53367a257b7f8.png[/img]
Meet [b]Akito[/b]! This runner uses his voice as a weapon, and you’re not prepared to hear it! His howl is so loud that nearby runners just fall on the ground, while Akito makes his way to the finish line. A dog treat won’t help in this situation, so just get as far as possible if you think that Akito is preparing to howl! 

Choose [b]Akito[/b] if you want to take your competition by surprise and clench the victory only by using your voice. 

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoyed learning more about the characters of RunOut. Who’s your favorite so far?
And that’s not all of them. In the next devlog, you’ll learn about more runners that will be available in RunOut! 

For now, join our Discord to meet other Runners like you, and be prepared to try the game when it's available!

[url=https://discord.gg/CAkuyykTBq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44389075/eacd78a76f79c6d7ac4a937b9bfad22a908e516b.gif[/img][/url]
